example.title: Pier-foot plaza pavilion with flagpole, Pismo Beach
example.place: Pismo Beach, San Luis Obispo County, CA

brief: A small timber kiosk-pavilion on the raised plaza at the foot of the pier: a square hip-roofed booth with a railed timber deck around, a tall flagpole, crowds on the promenade and the town behind. One photo. Piles 10 m below the bed (spec rule 4).
